title: Shinonome Ena — Behind The Scenes At The Sports Festival〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: Behind The Scenes At The Sports Festival（2★）

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
Classes are such a pain. I just wanna go home and keep working on my illustration.)

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Hey, what are you gonna do for the Sports Festival?

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm totally go see it!
I'm really looking forward to the cheering competition!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The Sports Festival...? Wow, it's already that time of year. Our school's cheering competition's supposed to be really good too...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But it's not like I'm gonna be in it or anything, so whatever, I guess...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mom, I'm getting kinda hungry. Have any late-night snacks I can...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (He's sleeping while sitting up on the sofa. Weird...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Akito... Hey, Akito.
You'll catch a cold if you sleep out here like this.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yes, it's me.
If you need to sleep, do it in your room.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Mom's taking a bath and I was waiting for her. No cutting, got it...?

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line:
I'm all done, Akito!
The bath's all yours.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Alright, go take your bath.
But don't come crying to me if you fall asleep and drown.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, good timing.
About those assets you made for me yesterday... Can you adjust the coloring a bit for me?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Amia, I fixed that part you were talking about.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Um, K, Yuki?
Did Amia log out for the day?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Huh? No, I haven't heard anything regarding that...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. I hope Amia doesn't catch a cold...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That reminds me. When Amia logged in, I remember hearing something about going to school every day...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, Amia's also apparently making a video for something else. That may be taking its toll.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Really? A video for something else? Like what?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I didn't get to ask...
Amia showed me this storyboard and asked me about any songs that would go well with it.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But the storyboard itself looked really amazing, so I'd like to see this video once it's done.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, K... Amia still has plenty of time to work on our stuff, right?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. We still have more than enough time.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay. I'd rather just let Amia sleep, so I'll just send this data over for now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Still... A video for something else, huh?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (After what Kanade said, I kinda want to see it now too.)
